content: All the RAMEN models are built from English and tuned on English for zero-shot cross-lingual tasks. It is reasonable to expect RAMENs do well in those tasks as we have shown in our experiments. But are they also a good feature extractor for supervised tasks? We offer a partial answer to this question by evaluating our model for supervised dependency parsing on UD datasets.
